- [CVE-2026-53590](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-53590)
- [GHSA-8g7x-c9fg-g6mh](https://github.com/eProsima/Fast-DDS/security/advisories/GHSA-8g7x-c9fg-g6mh)

These CVEs were addressed in squashed commits applied directly from privately reviewed branches (no public PR):

- Fix CVE-2026-22591 (CVE-2026-22591)
- Fix CVEs in Access Control parser (CVE-2026-45094, CVE-2026-45095, CVE-2026-45096)
- Fix several CVEs (CVE-2025-63829, CVE-2025-65865, CVE-2026-45093, CVE-2026-45092)
- Fix CVE-2025-67108 (CVE-2025-67108)
- Fix several deserialization CVEs (CVE-2026-49861, CVE-2026-53589, CVE-2026-45098, CVE-2026-49862, CVE-2026-55063, CVE-2026-49863, CVE-2026-53588, CVE-2026-53590)
- Fix integer overflow in PartitionQosPolicy CDR deserialization (GHSA-8g7x-c9fg-g6mh)

## Fixes

- Fix RTPSParticipantAttributes internal data races (#6389)
- Catch exception when constructing a payload pool Node (#6462)
- Fix dereference error of 'shared_secret_handle' (#6407)
- Assert liveliness with periodic heartbeats in secure participants (#6414)
- Make `on_xxx_matched` thread-safe (#6382)
- Fix data races on DataWriterImpl QoS access (#6424)
- Remove stale tcp channels (#6459)
- Fix unused variable on GCC 16 (#6466)
- Fix datasharing infinite loop (#6494)
- Fix shared-memory segment crash on port open (#6507)

## Improvements

- Regenerate types with Fast DDS Gen 3.3.3 (#6515)
- Update Fast CDR submodule (#6519)

## CI improvements

- Improve windows tests (#6377)
- Update security tests to use governance-based encryption configuration (#6396)
- Add UBSan workflow and solve its errors (#6417)
- Make `skip-ci` label report required statuses as pass (#6445)
- Fix Docs after HTML zip refactor (#6522)

---

**PRs (merge order):** #6389, #6445, #6462, #6377, #6396, #6407, #6414, #6382, #6424, #6459, #6466, #6494, #6417, #6507, #6515, #6519, #6520, #6522
